name: Calendar, Day
description: Today's agenda with tunable event text sizing, a configurable visible-hour range, and a location toggle. Reads from feeds configured in Widgets → Calendar Feeds; each feed's colour drives the stripe / marker / fill colour.

cell_options.name: day_start_hour
cell_options.label: Day starts at
cell_options.help: Hour the visible timetable starts (0-24). -1 = auto-fit to events. Set to 0 (with Day ends at = 24) to always show the whole day.

cell_options.name: day_end_hour
cell_options.label: Day ends at
cell_options.help: Hour the visible timetable ends (0-24). -1 = auto-fit to events. Set to 24 (with Day starts at = 0) to always show the whole day.

cell_options.name: show_density
cell_options.label: Show event-density strip
cell_options.help: The heatmap strip above the timetable showing which hours are busiest. Off removes it entirely.

cell_options.name: header_scale
cell_options.label: Header size (weekday / date)
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the top weekday/day-number/month-year header text.

cell_options.name: axis_label_scale
cell_options.label: Time axis label size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the hour-gutter time labels (08:00, 10:00, ...).

cell_options.name: event_title_scale
cell_options.label: Event title size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the event title font size. 1.0 = default.

cell_options.name: event_time_scale
cell_options.label: Event time size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the event time-range font size.

cell_options.name: event_location_scale
cell_options.label: Event location size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the location text font size.

cell_options.name: event_row_padding_em
cell_options.label: Event block spacing
cell_options.help: Extra padding added inside each event block, on top of the default. 0 = default.
